2611.18740.tldr: Discrete-token world model generating residuals over a regression forecast for typhoon satellite imagery ensembles.
2611.18740.summary: TyphoonWorld matches regression MSE while producing coherent, storm-dependent ensemble spread on Digital Typhoon.
2611.18740.why: Weather forecasting; residual-generation idea only loosely relevant.

2611.14880.tldr: Model-based Dreamer variant with factored opponent modeling for training cyber-defense policies in real networks.
2611.14880.summary: FOE-Dreamer trains defenders online in operational cloud networks with improved sample efficiency.

2611.15974.tldr: Video-action model with web/industrial video pretraining and an action expert for data-efficient industrial manipulation.
2611.15974.summary: FLUX-mimic jointly trains video and action on four automotive manufacturing tasks, studying how much action data is needed.
2611.15974.why: Evidence for video-pretrained policies in precise real tasks.

2611.15689.tldr: Ablation study of world-model representations for active object search with imperfect detectors.
2611.15689.summary: BAMOS shows target belief and its update matter most as detection errors increase, in Isaac Sim and HSSD houses.

2611.15488.tldr: Conditional flow matching predicts compact forward occupancy sets of vehicles as unions of convex polygons.
2611.15488.summary: FloCOS trains with coverage and area losses and plugs into hyperplane collision constraints, evaluated on Waymo.

2611.15317.tldr: LLM plus temporal partial-order planning for coordinating long-horizon bimanual manipulation.
2611.15317.summary: BiPOP models arm reachability, assignment and synchronization to compose unimanual and bimanual skills efficiently.

2611.15078.tldr: Crowdsources multiple alternative actions per visited robot state via a web 3D interface to widen IL datasets.
2611.15078.summary: CrowdMAPS lets non-experts annotate keyframe goal poses; increasing width from 1 to 10 actions per state improves sample efficiency across five real tasks.
2611.15078.why: Interesting data-scaling axis for multimodal generative policies.

2611.15048.tldr: Position paper arguing world models should be audited via action-sensitivity analysis of counterfactual responses.
2611.15048.summary: Proposes inspecting forced responses to action perturbations rather than only reconstruction or task success.

2611.14955.tldr: Single-seed case study showing RSSM imagined rollouts lose obstacle information that posterior states retain.
2611.14955.summary: Probe AUC decays 0.85 to 0.71 over 15 imagined steps in CARLA, and ensemble disagreement fails to flag it.
2611.14955.why: Interesting diagnostic but driving and narrow.

2611.15296.tldr: Analytic policy gradient via differential flatness trains a vision-based high-speed trajectory planner.
2611.15296.summary: APG-Planner reconstructs states from planned trajectories for differentiable transitions, improving training efficiency over model-free RL.
2611.15296.why: Drone navigation; APG idea partially transferable.

2611.15082.tldr: Shows video world-model prediction scores conflate encoder quality and persistence, isolating the predictor's true contribution.
2611.15082.summary: Using paired persistence controls on 27k egocentric future-retrieval trials, the predictor adds +0.291 top-1 for V-JEPA 2.1 but only ~+0.03 for V-JEPA 2, and is negative for some models.
2611.15082.why: Careful analysis of V-JEPA-style world models used for robot learning.

2611.15983.tldr: Training-free resolution extension for video diffusion by synchronizing low- and high-res denoising trajectories.
2611.15983.summary: TRACE aligns content early, refines details with window attention, and fixes duplicate subjects.

2611.15360.tldr: Driving VLA refinement decomposed into waypoint residual correction and position-conditioned heading generation.
2611.15360.summary: CARE-Drive uses coupled position and heading experts on top of an IL backbone.

2611.15131.tldr: Full-duplex audiovisual 'reciprocal world model' that perceives and responds in real time.
2611.15131.summary: Duo v1 couples autoregressive intent reasoning with chunk-synchronized audio-visual realization.

2611.16020.tldr: Learns per-demonstrator latent expertise and state-action optimality scores from mixed-quality data, then uses them for online policy optimization.
2611.16020.summary: LEOS-IL handles heterogeneous imperfect demonstrators without labels, integrating the scoring model into offline-to-online training.
2611.16020.why: Relevant to learning from low-quality data.

2611.14903.tldr: Epigraph-form RL for safe trajectory tracking of connected autonomous vehicles.
2611.14903.summary: Reformulates constrained tracking as epigraph min-max to avoid Lagrangian instability.

2611.15937.tldr: Adds role-specific mask grounding and geometric tokens to pretrained VLAs for obstacle-aware manipulation in clutter.
2611.15937.summary: MOSAIC predicts target/destination/obstacle masks and injects depth-derived tokens into the action expert.

2611.15659.tldr: Lightweight policy using 6-DoF grasp hypotheses as explicit geometric priors with point clouds and language.
2611.15659.summary: GraSLA binds task-relevant grasp hypotheses to scene and instruction via cross-attention and decodes continuous actions.

2611.15389.tldr: Physics-constrained maskable PPO for autonomous Titan probe mission planning.
2611.15389.summary: Incorporates orbital dynamics and opportunity targets in a discrete MDP.

2611.15934.tldr: Solves MPC QPs via dual-space continuous-time flow implemented on analogue hardware.
2611.15934.summary: Demonstrates linear MPC on an analog computer and extends to nonlinear MPC.

2611.16423.tldr: Plug-in perception modules that estimate object velocity/acceleration and refine pose for vision-based in-hand manipulation.
2611.16423.summary: Off-the-shelf pose estimators give static states, leaving controllers to infer dynamics from noise. VOKE adds a Pluggable Kinematics Module predicting linear/angular velocity and acceleration from temporal visual features and a kinematics-guided pose refinement module, with a downstream in-hand manipulation study.
2611.16423.why: Directly targets perception for dexterous in-hand manipulation.

2611.17159.tldr: Regularizes IL policies so the same state perturbation shifts outputs consistently across nearby states, via a Jacobian-induced inner product.
2611.17159.summary: InneR shows the action-space inner product induces a state-space inner product through the policy Jacobian (Fisher information for stochastic policies) and penalizes inconsistency across states, improving robustness to sensor noise, scene variation and compounding error.
2611.17159.why: A principled, plausibly usable robustness regularizer for BC policies.

2611.16417.tldr: Video diffusion model converting third-person footage into first-person views of a chosen actor, plus a lightweight paired-capture app.
2611.16417.summary: Built on a pretrained video DiT with geometric guidance and mask/hand-keypoint supervision; camera geometry is stochastically dropped so inference needs no calibration.
2611.16417.why: Synthetic egocentric hand-object data could feed human-to-robot learning.

2611.17324.tldr: LLM-backed keyframe generation followed by video interpolation for more physically plausible video.
2611.17324.summary: K2V moves physical reasoning to explicit language-driven keyframes so the diffusion model only interpolates, outperforming baselines on physical plausibility.

2611.17394.tldr: Coding-agent data engine that writes code policies from VLA failure states to generate corrective demos for post-training.
2611.17394.summary: Agentic-Teacher analyzes failed rollouts, picks intervention states, iteratively develops validated code policies, then collects continuations with temporally correlated action noise and idle-frame removal for effective VLA supervision.
2611.17394.why: Practical failure-driven data recipe for VLA fine-tuning.

2611.16246.tldr: Distills LLM-planner + VLA sessions into a standalone navigation VLA, masking off-goal steps.
2611.16246.summary: H2E keeps successful sessions, relabels all motions as VLA actions for the original task, and trains a VLA that needs no LLM at test time.

2611.16419.tldr: Dataset and fine-tuned VLM for inferring atomic action and mission intent from visual teleoperation history.
2611.16419.summary: VI AMO has 6,600 episodes from 11 robot sources; proprietary VLMs score poorly while the fine-tuned model improves.

2611.17336.tldr: Lifts a pretrained latent video DiT to generate frames directly in pixel space with a convolutional head.
2611.17336.summary: PixVid finds x-prediction with larger noise shift is key; finetuned from Wan2.1-14B on ~1.3M clips it matches the latent baseline while enabling framewise, faster interactive generation.
2611.17336.why: Insight on x-prediction/noise shift relevant to generative modeling and interactive world models.

2611.17034.tldr: Review of the control-Gibbs distribution unifying max-entropy control, control-as-inference, MPPI and EBM control.
2611.17034.summary: Positions the Gibbs distribution over control sequences as central, reviews dynamic programming extensions for closed-loop distributions and sampling methods.
2611.17034.why: Nice conceptual bridge between MPPI and energy-based/diffusion samplers.

2611.16424.tldr: Benchmark for physically grounded video captions spanning internet and embodied videos.
2611.16424.summary: PhysCapBench assesses whether captions preserve interactions and state transitions for world-model pretraining data.

2611.17005.tldr: Data-efficient neural imitation of nonlinear time-optimal MPC with self-informed expert sampling.
2611.17005.summary: SIFS queries the expensive expert only where the policy deviates, within an architecture addressing covariate shift, constraints and model mismatch, run in real time.
2611.17005.why: DAgger-like ideas for MPC distillation; tangential.

2611.16728.tldr: Cross-embodiment pretraining over human, robot and sim data with modality-specific tokenizers/experts and a latent future-prediction objective.
2611.16728.summary: EgoX's Modular Embodiment Dreamer shares a transformer trunk across embodiments while keeping per-modality tokenizers and action experts, plus an embodiment-dreaming loss predicting future latents, then fine-tunes on the target robot.
2611.16728.why: Relevant to leveraging egocentric human data in policies.

2611.16589.tldr: Adds geometry-foundation-model features to temporal memory with a relevance/complementarity scoring rule for VLAs.
2611.16589.summary: STVLA evaluates on LIBERO, LIBERO-Mem, MIKASA-Robo and SimplerEnv.

2611.16374.tldr: Simulation benchmark of 112 manipulation tasks stratified into four calibrated difficulty levels including dexterous hands.
2611.16374.summary: ManiLadder calibrates difficulty using a fixed-data flow-matching IL policy's success rate across rigid, deformable, bimanual and dexterous tasks.
2611.16374.why: Possibly useful benchmark incl. dexterous tasks.

2611.17318.tldr: Dataset of 5,280 residential 3D scenes with aligned RGB, depth, meshes, boxes and camera trajectories.
2611.17318.summary: Spatial Foundry supports spatial intelligence tasks with editable scenes.

2611.16897.tldr: Composes independently learned subject identities in T2V with token-wise LoRA and guided attention.
2611.16897.summary: TokenStream improves multi-subject identity preservation on a new benchmark.

2611.17529.tldr: Learns a residual adapter on frozen I-JEPA embeddings as a better goal cost for world-model planning via expanding curriculum.
2611.17529.summary: Trained from trajectory ordering without progress labels, improving planning success on DotWall and PointMaze.
2611.17529.why: Goal costs for latent world-model planning; toy settings.

2611.17110.tldr: Latent action model aligned with language semantics so human and robot latent actions correspond without paired data.
2611.17110.summary: SALA uses language descriptions of unpaired human and robot clips to make latent actions cluster by action rather than appearance, enabling scaling with both human video and robot data.
2611.17110.why: Relevant to human-video pretraining for policies.

2611.17221.tldr: Parallel linear solver for multi-horizon (scenario-tree) optimal control integrated into QPALM.
2611.17221.summary: FanCyqlone parallelizes over time and branches; benchmarked on spring-mass and quadruped control.

2611.17134.tldr: Support-constrained fitted Q-iteration for cautious offline policy improvement in pediatric ECMO.
2611.17134.summary: Restricts optimization to supported state-actions on 78 trajectories and introduces a balance score.

2611.16537.tldr: Incremental MPC for reference tracking of Wiener-model anesthesia dynamics.
2611.16537.summary: Linear reformulation exploiting output nonlinearity, tested on 1000 virtual patients.

2611.16301.tldr: Local coordination in JAX to cut host orchestration overhead for small-model LLM RL on TPUs.
2611.16301.summary: At 0.6B, host orchestration is 36% of step time; LoCoJAX localizes rollouts and rewards.

2611.17504.tldr: Learns game-theoretic linear MPC weights by imitation from multi-agent I/O data with strong monotonicity guarantees.
2611.17504.summary: Ensures unique differentiable GNE for gradient-based learning.

2611.16913.tldr: Synthetic PCB boards with executable EDA demonstrations for BC+RL routing policies.
2611.16913.summary: RouteDemos provides 100k DRV-free routed boards; BC then RL improves complete routing on real boards.

2611.16175.tldr: PPO on many procedurally generated Mario levels plus DRAIL fine-tuning for human-like play.
2611.16175.summary: More training levels improve generalization; diffusion-reward adversarial IL increases human-likeness.

2611.17442.tldr: Budget-conditioned object search for VLN, comparing Bellman experts with different scene abstractions.
2611.17442.summary: Experts with object- vs room-level knowledge yield different students for maximizing distinct discoveries.

2611.17163.tldr: Dataset, benchmark and VLA for short-range language-guided UAV flight maneuvers.
2611.17163.summary: UAV-Flow has 30k real and 10k sim trajectories; FlowVLA trained on mixed data.

2611.16645.tldr: Learned GP-based continuity priors over action history for sampling proposals in visual world-model planning.
2611.16645.summary: LG-DKGP combines neural continuation and temporal GP residual to initialize planning search, reaching 87.07% macro success over five sim tasks.
2611.16645.why: Connects action temporal structure to planning; modest.

2611.16188.tldr: Adds plug-in experts to a frozen MoE humanoid motion policy for continual whole-body skill learning.
2611.16188.summary: Each module is ~1% of parameters; all ten new tasks completed while preserving 126 original motions in G1 sim.

2611.17603.tldr: Minimax sample complexity of offline KL-regularized RL in stochastic MDPs.
2611.17603.summary: Proves an Omega(KCH^3/(eps max{eps,beta})) lower bound and matching pessimistic soft value iteration upper bound, plus coverage results for reference-policy data.
2611.17603.why: Theory relevant to KL-regularized fine-tuning, but abstract.

2611.18976.tldr: Tactile-driven motor adaptation enables zero-shot sim-to-real forceful multi-finger humanoid manipulation, demonstrated on round-doorknob opening.
2611.18976.summary: Forceful multi-finger tasks need adaptation to uncertain contact dynamics. TMA structures policy learning around tactile-observable interactions, uses cone geometry as a contact inductive bias, and adapts motor behavior online from tactile history within a whole-body system, transferring zero-shot to real doorknob opening.
2611.18976.why: Tactile sim-to-real for multi-fingered hands, squarely in core interests.

2611.18372.tldr: Life-cycle survey of 89 VLA works organized along seven design, training and deployment axes, comparing 22 models.
2611.18372.summary: Covers inputs/memory, architecture, action output, intermediate predictions, pretraining data, post-training, and real-time execution, from RT-2 through late 2026.

2611.17619.tldr: Rebuilds human demos with an 880-taxel glove in MuJoCo so dexterous policies learn correct contact forces, closing a vision-only 'force gap'.
2611.17619.summary: Vision-based real-to-sim-to-real recovers hand motion but not touch: pose imitation grips at 0.31x recorded force and physics replay at 1.55x. TouchTwin reconstructs TouchScale recordings (head/wrist RGB-D plus tactile glove) in MuJoCo with agent-written physics-tested objects and a per-subject tactile hand replaying recorded touch, scaling human touch data for dexterous policies.
2611.17619.why: Human hand data plus tactile sensing plus sim-to-real for hands: core.

2611.17831.tldr: Shows VLMs ignore dynamics encoded by V-JEPA and builds counterfactual supervision to make the LM read them.
2611.17831.summary: A linear probe reads speed from frozen V-JEPA at 87% while the VLM is at chance; dynamics lie in a shared subspace for predictive encoders but not SigLIP. Pixel-transformed answer-balanced videos fix this.
2611.17831.why: Insight on V-JEPA representations, indirectly relevant to VLA encoders.

2611.18822.tldr: Technical report on an audio-driven long avatar video generator with RL, CFG and DMD distillation improvements.
2611.18822.summary: LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6 supports 10+ minute videos with better lip sync and motion.

2611.18390.tldr: Sampling-based MPC with contraction-certified feedback in each rollout plus CBF-verified execution for safety.
2611.18390.summary: CS-MPC proves stochastic stability and probabilistic safety, matching MPPI tracking with 7-20x fewer rollouts on rover, quadrotor and asteroid landing.
2611.18390.why: Improves MPPI efficiency; control interest but not manipulation.

2611.18866.tldr: Screenplay-driven framework decoupling audio and visual tracks for long multi-shot generation.
2611.18866.summary: Découpage controls J/L-cuts and silences for multi-character audio-video generation.

2611.18397.tldr: Generalist VLA game agent pretrained on keyboard/mouse interaction and trained with multi-turn RL.
2611.18397.summary: Gamer combines memory, sparse-thinking instruction tuning, and stable long-horizon RL across 2D GUIs and 3D worlds.

2611.18298.tldr: A VLM writes staged cost programs for a shared sampling-based MPC to perform contact-rich manipulation via real-to-sim digital twins.
2611.18298.summary: Objectives as Policies builds a digital twin, has the VLM generate stage costs and completion conditions from a cost library, and runs sampling MPC.
2611.18298.why: Combines VLMs with contact-rich MPC; relevant to control interest.

2611.18543.tldr: Extends IBRL to cooperative MARL using round-robin BC proposals selected by centralized critics.
2611.18543.summary: IBMARL picks per-agent imitation or RL actions via a critic ensemble, improving over demonstrations.

2611.18176.tldr: Self-improvement flywheel jointly refining LLM prompts, skill interface and VLA parameters from interaction.
2611.18176.summary: ESI uses LLM subtask decisions as supervision to align VLA execution in modular agents.

2611.17631.tldr: Careful study of pretrained visual representations vs contact-centric representations for contact-rich insertion policies.
2611.17631.summary: Compares vision foundation model features with an explicit contact-centric representation on two insertion tasks under controlled occlusion and tolerance perturbations, testing real-world transfer; finds subtle task dependence.
2611.17631.why: Rigorous understanding paper on contact-rich IL (Posa/Jayaraman).

2611.17626.tldr: Trains joint world-action generators by differentiating task loss through dynamics-constrained trajectory optimization.
2611.17626.summary: WATO uses generated actions and states as references in a differentiable trajectory optimization during training only; at deployment it samples and ranks with a world model. Across 7 visual control environments it raises success from 79.9% for imitation joint WAMs.
2611.17626.why: Combines generative trajectory models with trajectory optimization; a novel training signal.

2611.18891.tldr: Merges VLA and base VLM weights via SVD-decomposed task vectors with learned per-component coefficients to restore VL skills.
2611.18891.summary: Learns scalar mixing per singular component to preserve both action prediction and vision-language capabilities, beating merging baselines.
2611.18891.why: Cheap fix for VLA catastrophic forgetting.

2611.18549.tldr: Simple large-patch DiT for pixel-space video diffusion without autoencoder, competitive with latent baselines.
2611.18549.summary: JVT studies patch embeddings, registers and adaLN; supports joint RGB-disparity generation improving camera following.

2611.17938.tldr: Estimates the environmental footprint of commercial AI video generation and projects growth to 2030.
2611.17938.summary: Under continued growth emissions rise ~75x by 2030 despite efficiency gains.

2611.17755.tldr: Vertex-aligned decoder for dense per-vertex hand contact estimation from a single RGB image.
2611.17755.summary: VACO samples image features at each projected MANO vertex, setting SOTA on five benchmarks with +20.7 pp F1.
2611.17755.why: Hand contact extraction from images can supervise learning from human video.

2611.18562.tldr: RL-trains an open 27B reasoning model in simulation to output end-effector poses and control real robots without demos.
2611.18562.summary: PEAR scales robot-use RL in sim; skills generalize beyond training tasks and transfer to real robots, approaching proprietary robot-use agents.
2611.18562.why: Interesting alternate VLA paradigm, though coarse control.

2611.18451.tldr: Koopman model conditioned on controller parameters to predict a family of closed-loop trajectories.
2611.18451.summary: Stays under 15% error on six benchmarks and enables one-shot feedback-parameter selection.

2611.18393.tldr: Weather world model that learns data assimilation end-to-end from 18 observing systems.
2611.18393.summary: WeatherDreamer beats GEFS ensembles for temperature, dew point and wind out to 12 h at held-out stations.

2611.18807.tldr: Procedure certifying whether world-model latents faithfully recover ground-truth dynamics up to affine gauge, tested on TD-MPC2.
2611.18807.summary: ARC uses discrete Fréchet distances and latent steering on a pendulum.

2611.18979.tldr: Localized violation-of-expectation evaluation of V-JEPA video world models' intuitive physics.
2611.18979.summary: Global and localized VOE judgments can diverge in both directions.

2611.18919.tldr: Mines persistent RL grasping failures and gets human VR grasp-point demos to fix them.
2611.18919.summary: Humans contribute only grasp points in VR, returned to training of a point-cloud grasping policy.

2611.18043.tldr: Surrogate-guided RL for virtual screening of perovskite solar cell recipes.
2611.18043.summary: TabPFN-guided PPO raises top-ten PCE from 19.68% to 23.74%.

2611.17919.tldr: Edge-aware multi-scale flow matching to synthesize 3D brain MRI from vessel masks.

2611.17751.tldr: Controlled study of which cross-view consistency matters for multi-view augmentation in Diffusion Policy.
2611.17751.summary: Appearance inconsistencies cost little; geometric anti-coupling drops LIBERO success by 3.3 pp, with notable reliance on wrist-view geometry.
2611.17751.why: Small but careful augmentation insight for diffusion policies.

2611.17612.tldr: Constraint-aware RL controller for battery sizing and PV ramp-rate smoothing.

2611.18505.tldr: Two-stage informative planning with disturbance sampling and disturbance-aware trajectory optimization.
2611.18505.summary: Targets persistent monitoring under spatially varying disturbances.

2611.18496.tldr: Teleoperation interface with a SpaceMouse for recovering failures in self-driving laboratories.
2611.18496.summary: Compares coupled vs decoupled velocity mapping on a UR3e.

2611.18491.tldr: Hidden start-delay randomization makes self-play humanoid handover robust to unfamiliar partners.
2611.18491.summary: Receiver success with scripted partners rises from 31%, after showing learned partners always start immediately.

2611.19131.tldr: Edge-assisted framework jointly choosing execution location and latent reasoning depth for VLAs over wireless links.
2611.19131.summary: WEALR's decision agent trades task success, latency and energy for collaborative onboard/edge VLA inference.

2611.19559.tldr: World-action model supervising only the DINOv3 feature change from current to future frame instead of full future features.
2611.19559.summary: Full-future losses are dominated by copying static background. ResWAM's visual residual target yields higher-rank, more diverse representations of robot/object motion, improving policy learning without heavy video generators.
2611.19559.why: Simple, cheap auxiliary objective for VLA/WAM policies.

2611.19138.tldr: Turns a decoder-only VLM into a single-pass driving policy by scoring 5,273 fixed trajectories from its pre-token hidden state.
2611.19138.summary: SuperGlance uses offline rewards for reward-weighted supervision and RL, avoiding slow autoregressive planning.

2611.19187.tldr: Report proposing a unified control framework and math model spanning OSC, MPC, RL, active inference and diffusion policies.
2611.19187.summary: Argues all reduce to constrained sequential decision making, bridged by control-as-inference, with a five-layer case study.

2611.19318.tldr: Residual SAC policy on an inverse-Jacobian PI controller for conveyor tracking, transferred zero-shot from a digital twin.
2611.19318.summary: Reduces tracking error from 1.1-1.4 mm to 0.3-0.7 mm, below a derived model-based performance bound.
2611.19318.why: Residual RL in a narrow task.

2611.19616.tldr: Extends robust safe gradient-flow RL to general trajectory-level chance constraints with biased estimators, deployed on humanoid and aerial robots.
2611.19616.summary: Provides high-probability safety guarantees compatible with PPO.

2611.19190.tldr: Distills multi-agent CBF safety filters into RL policies via IQL on executed safe actions plus synthetic near-collision states.
2611.19190.summary: Enables filter-free deployment with bounded safety loss.

2611.19100.tldr: Sampling-based whole-body MPC lets a humanoid brace against surfaces to extend reach by ~50 cm.
2611.19100.summary: Runs at 34 Hz on Unitree H1-2, 89% reach and 81% full-cycle success over 54 trials.

2611.19215.tldr: Online fairness control for T2V generation via concept-conditioned memory and prompt interventions.
2611.19215.summary: Mem2Fair formulates fairness as conditional online approachability.

2611.19324.tldr: Routes between a frozen VLA and RL-trained atomic skill policies (anchored to VLA reference actions) for precise multi-stage manipulation.
2611.19324.summary: MARS trains specialist RL policies for grasping, alignment and insertion using shared RL Token states and VLA reference actions, dynamically switching during execution.
2611.19324.why: RL refinement of VLA policies for precision stages.

2611.19198.tldr: Training-free vision-agent-action pipeline that self-calibrates to new robot cells, beating LIBERO VLAs under hardware changes.
2611.19198.summary: Across 18 cells, refined VAA gets 74% vs 21% for the strongest released VLA.

2611.19466.tldr: Safe planning in a learned world model's latent space via successive convex programming with learned CBF constraints.
2611.19466.summary: Smooth Lipschitz networks bound linearization error; fewer violations than MPPI/CEM on Safety-Gymnasium.

2611.19196.tldr: Converts egocentric-glasses human recordings into physically verified humanoid loco-manipulation trajectories via agentic real-to-sim.
2611.19196.summary: Reconstructs assets from RGB-D/head streams, predicts contact bands, plans grasps and adapts motion to robot morphology, training VLAs without robot demonstrations.
2611.19196.why: Human-video-to-robot data pipeline with contact reasoning.

2611.19081.tldr: Failure-guided co-evolution of an MLLM agent's code-as-policy knowledge and VLA parameters.
2611.19081.summary: RoboCoEvo couples agent knowledge refinement with VLA learning iteratively.

2611.19440.tldr: Few-shot difference-of-means concept directions from DiT image activations for training-free steering.
2611.19440.summary: Finds global concepts distributed across tokens and local concepts concentrated regionally.

2611.19329.tldr: Gradient-based co-design of system parameters and RL policies via differentiable simulators and optimal-policy sensitivity.
2611.19329.summary: Decomposes the design gradient into direct and indirect (policy-sensitivity) effects, outperforming BO/ES.
2611.19329.why: Co-design could apply to hand design, but indirect.

2611.19183.tldr: JEPA world-action model that refines action proposals using goal-discrepancy feedback from latent predictions.
2611.19183.summary: WA-JEPA generates an action, predicts future latents, and corrects via goal-aware residual paths, avoiding costly candidate search.

2611.19621.tldr: Controlled ObjectNav evaluation isolating visual factors; surface materials drive most generalization drops.
2611.19621.summary: Compares model-free, model-based and frozen-representation agents in ProcTHOR.

2611.19587.tldr: Analyzes ill-posedness of empirical flow matching near data and proposes explicit regularization to avoid memorization.
2611.19587.summary: The empirical minimizer transports samples onto training data, so small data perturbations strongly change the velocity near t=1. The authors study explicit regularizers beyond velocity magnitude for better-posed flow matching.
2611.19587.why: Generative-model theory on flow matching generalization, a core interest.

2611.19388.tldr: Token-level advantage routing to reduce VLM hallucinations during RL post-training.

2611.19344.tldr: Delay-aware RL with LSTM delay prediction for O-RAN control.

2611.19252.tldr: Shows MPPI's exploration covariance sets its effective feedback gain, so too little exploration can destabilize the loop.
2611.19252.summary: For LQ problems with infinite samples, small exploration at fixed temperature makes MPPI nearly repeat its previous solution, yielding weak feedback and instability.

2611.19397.tldr: Multi-rate MPC coordinating frequency, AGC and voltage ancillary services in distribution networks.
2611.19397.summary: Uses power-energy envelopes for DER flexibility.

2611.19226.tldr: Transformer MoE guidance law trained with RL for multi-revolution low-thrust rendezvous.
2611.19226.summary: Cuts flight time and delta-v by ~50% and 44.5% vs hard switching.

2611.19660.tldr: Gradient-only single-loop method for K-step physics-based control through contact without KKT solves.
2611.19660.summary: PSK recasts K-level optimization as min-max with O(eps^-3) convergence and banded smooth walls handling contact constraints without constraint qualification.

2611.19034.tldr: Studies how a frozen chunked policy should split inference compute between denoising refinement and more frequent replanning.
2611.19034.summary: Using SmolVLA on LIBERO with K=50 chunks and denoising count as refinement control, it provides a pre-registered evaluation protocol and shows arithmetic and latency cost accounting diverge.
2611.19034.why: Directly about action chunking and diffusion-step tradeoffs, though small-scale.

2611.19078.tldr: Assume/guarantee contracts for compositional heterogeneous MARL.
2611.19078.summary: Automata-based contracts enable substitution and synchronization across agents.

2611.19566.tldr: Resolves minimax sample complexity of plug-in RL with a generative model for discounted and average-reward settings.
2611.19566.summary: Proves O(SA(1-gamma)^-3 eps^-2) for discounted and span/diameter-based bounds for average reward, matching lower bounds via Bellman residual bracketing.
2611.19566.why: Strong RL theory, but far from practice.

2611.19572.tldr: Steers frozen diffusion generators with local inverse Jacobian corrections and predicts when guidance will succeed.
2611.19572.summary: Spectral steering's predicted gain correlates with realized gain at Spearman 0.79 over 8,923 instances across images, audio, robotics and motion generation.
2611.19572.why: Guidance analysis applicable to diffusion policies.

2611.19088.tldr: Conditioned HJ reachability learned on local windows with conservative-side error.
2611.19088.summary: Capping obstacle margin makes the value function local so it transfers from small scenes.

2611.19815.tldr: Frames imitation as triangular transport from an empirical action-chunk reference, giving OT, flow-matching, and stochastic-interpolant policies.
2611.19815.summary: Diffusion Policy fixes a Gaussian source; this work makes the reference distribution a design choice by casting policies as the second block of a triangular transport map, using the empirical demo action-chunk distribution as source. Three instances (OTP, FMP, SIP) match Diffusion/Consistency Policy on Push-T and robomimic Square with much smaller networks; OTP produces a chunk in one evaluation of a 0.23M-parameter net.
2611.19815.why: Directly relevant to source-distribution choice and few-step generative policies, tying stochastic interpolants to IL.

2611.20273.tldr: Single Transformer-XL RL policy for dexterous grasping across 18 arm-hand pairs, transferring to unseen hands and real robots.
2611.20273.summary: Cross-embodiment dexterous grasping is addressed with a canonical joint interface with validity masks, kinematic-tree-biased attention, and Transformer-XL memory to infer dynamics. Trained on 4 arms x 6 hands it gets 89% seen / 51% held-out-pair success, grasps with 4 new hands zero-shot, and distilled students transfer zero-shot to a real Flexiv arm.
2611.20273.why: Cross-embodiment sim-to-real for multi-fingered hands, a core interest.

2611.20010.tldr: PlanDiv makes VLA test-time candidates differ by latent plan rather than noise, decoded by a masked-diffusion executor.
2611.20010.summary: Test-time resampling from one decoder yields candidates differing only by noise, with diminishing returns. PlanDiv proposes K latent plans learned from demos and decodes a chunk per plan in one backbone pass, ranking by likelihood; 8 plans raise CALVIN ABC->D 5-chain success from 56.9% to 69.9% (vs <=64.9% for resampling) and win on real Franka multi-solution tasks (51/54 vs 40/54).
2611.20010.why: Clean analysis of test-time scaling for generative action heads with a controlled same-plan baseline.

2611.19771.tldr: JEPA world model on single-depth-camera point clouds that plans in latent space and transfers zero-shot to real gripper and dexterous hand.
2611.19771.summary: JEPA4R predicts future latent embeddings of point clouds, with a decoder visualizing imagined 4D points (1.1 cm error over 200 steps) and a policy head on frozen latents. It beats pixel JEPAs on OGBench cube/scene tasks, scores 98.4% MetaWorld and 88.0% Adroit Relocate, and runs zero-shot real after digital-twin training.
2611.19771.why: V-JEPA-style 3D world model with dexterous-hand deployment; moderately relevant.

2611.20314.tldr: NF-VLA trains VLA action heads with autoregressive normalizing flows by exact likelihood plus a single score-based refinement step.
2611.20314.summary: Instead of diffusion/flow matching, NF-VLA uses conditional autoregressive normalizing flows with a deep-shallow architecture trained by maximum likelihood on Gaussian-smoothed action chunks, then uses the learned density's score for one refinement step. From a VLM without robot pretraining it reaches 98.35% on LIBERO and 72.6% on LIBERO-Plus.
2611.20314.why: An alternative generative policy class with tractable density, useful for RL likelihoods.

2611.19998.tldr: MoViC drives humanoid whole-body control in real time from monocular RGB video via reconstruction, retargeting, and a behavior foundation model.
2611.19998.summary: The system combines monocular human motion reconstruction with retargeting and a transformer tracker using a compact frequency-domain motion representation, plus extrapolation bridging 10 Hz vision to a 50 Hz controller. Hardware demos show dynamic tracking and device-free teleoperation of manipulation.
2611.19998.why: Humanoid teleoperation; tangential to dexterous manipulation learning.

2611.20202.tldr: DAPPT learns sim-to-real dexterous tool use with deformables by tracking procedural trajectories conditioned on domain parameters, without simulating materials.
2611.20202.summary: Dexterous tasks with sand or play-dough are too slow to simulate for RL. DAPPT trains domain-aware RL policies tracking parameterized procedural trajectories, distills them into sensorimotor policies, and selects domain parameters to maximize task metrics; across six tasks (scooping, rod rolling, spray triggering, etc.) it gives 1.5-3.8x task metrics and zero-shot real transfer.
2611.20202.why: Clever sim-to-real recipe extending dexterous RL to non-rigid tool use (Jia Deng group).

2611.19774.tldr: Designs suppression-aware backdoor attacks on VLAs that can be switched off via instruction tokens and evade detectors.
2611.19774.summary: The paper introduces conjunctive-trigger backdoors with instruction-conditioned suppression on SmolVLA and OpenVLA. Variants cut Isolation Forest detection from 96-98% to 1-18% with 63-71% attack success and intact clean performance.

2611.19681.tldr: RIFT augments target offline RL data by transferring low-to-high reward displacement fields learned from source domains via optimal transport.
2611.19681.summary: For cross-domain offline RL, RIFT encodes transitions in a shared latent space, pairs low/high-reward source transitions with OT, fits an affine displacement field, and applies it to target anchors. Theory bounds synthesis error and experiments on locomotion with gravity/morphology/friction shifts show gains.
2611.19681.why: Offline RL data augmentation; limited to locomotion benchmarks.

2611.20307.tldr: Training-free sparse attention for video diffusion separating offline positional prior from online content keys.
2611.20307.summary: PoCoAttn shows video attention decomposes into an input-stable positional prior plus small content residual, retrieves positional keys from calibrated tables and content keys online, and allocates sparsity per denoising step. It improves PSNR 1.9-5.0 dB over sparse baselines with up to 2.0x denoising speedup over FlashAttention-3.

2611.20244.tldr: ReGround keeps a VLA frozen and re-grounds its intended motion using dynamics learned from motor babbling under actuation shift.
2611.20244.summary: When latency, remounting, or wear changes actuation, ReGround detects shift, learns deployed dynamics from task-agnostic babbling, and tracks the policy's intended motion near its plan. Across two VLAs, 8 LIBERO tasks, and 5 shifts it restores near-oracle success, e.g. pi0.5 from 0.16 to 0.90 under 400 ms latency.
2611.20244.why: Practical inference-time robustness for deployed VLAs.

2611.19733.tldr: Combines MeanQ ensembling with BBF to scale sample-efficient Atari RL capacity effectively.
2611.19733.summary: Naively scaling BBF hurts performance; MeanQ-BBF organizes extra parameters as largely independent ensemble learners. Rigorous Atari 100K evaluation shows gains over BBF at efficient compute.

2611.20185.tldr: RoboKit is a GPU-parallel differentiable optimization toolkit for robotics, e.g. 4096 grasps in 2.97 s, with policy distillation and RL support.
2611.20185.summary: RoboKit pairs sampling with multi-seed optimizers and hybrid geometry/rendering/physics representations, running 2-60x faster than task-specific baselines across seven tasks. Distilled policies are 9-240x faster at comparable accuracy and RL reaches baseline scores up to 2.1x sooner.
2611.20185.why: Useful tooling for grasp synthesis and optimization-based data generation for hands.

2611.19720.tldr: Deploys a room-probability ObjectNav policy on Spot and TurtleBot 4 via ROS 2 and analyzes sim-to-real gaps.
2611.19720.summary: RPV achieves 0.455 real success over 66 Spot trials vs 0.539 in simulation, with failures attributed to glass walls, depth range, and lexicon mismatch.

2611.20268.tldr: PPO on a heterogeneous graph learns timing of coastal flood emergency actions for Venice Lido.
2611.20268.summary: Using decades of tide records, a GNN PPO policy matches a tuned rule-based officer on 18 historical storms; message passing is not crucial.
2611.20268.why: Applied RL for disaster response; irrelevant.

2611.19825.tldr: FP2 is a flow-matching diffusion-transformer policy for offline multi-objective RL with pre/mid/post-training stages.
2611.19825.summary: Foundation Pareto Flow Policy trains a multimodal DiT with flow matching on large MORL data, then curated data, then few-shot new tasks. It beats prior methods on most D4MORL tasks with zero-shot Pareto interpolation/extrapolation.
2611.19825.why: Flow policies in offline RL, but MORL benchmark focus.

2611.20107.tldr: SAFER learns a chunked latent world model planner for driving from staged expert-annotated failures plus online refinement.
2611.20107.summary: Offline staged failures with expert annotations broaden coverage; a risk-aware sampling planner uses the world model, refined online. It tops CARLA route completion (0.95) and MetaDrive reward.

2611.19850.tldr: Proves sharp O(n^{-1/4}) Wasserstein Gaussian approximation rates for asynchronous averaged Q-learning with matching lower bound.
2611.19850.summary: The analysis separates Bellman nonlinearity, Markovian noise, and covariance discrepancy, showing Markovian noise induces unavoidable bias. Synchronous setting attains O(n^{-1/2}).

2611.19712.tldr: Shows closed-form diffusion policy weights equal the solution of a regularized behavioral control problem, yielding chi^2-projected behavioral denoising.
2611.19712.summary: Building on findings that low-data diffusion policies retrieve/combine demos, the authors prove the closed-form diffusion policy's combination weights uniquely solve a regularized behavioral (data-driven) control problem. A training-free chi^2-projected variant limits extrapolation and performs well on four nonlinear control tasks.
2611.19712.why: A rigorous 'why diffusion policies work' link to data-driven control (Manchester lab).

2611.20137.tldr: Learns visual task spaces from frozen DINO features for cleaning tasks, used as encoder and reward.
2611.20137.summary: Cleanly-DINO fits a projection and progression metric on ViT features given a task mask, localizes uncleaned regions, transfers across domains, and serves as RL reward and in a real wiping pipeline.

2611.20075.tldr: Studies prompt re-specification for SAM-mask visual RL drone landing under new pad appearances.
2611.20075.summary: A revised SAM 3 prompt restored landing success from 12.0% to 68.4% on a new pad without retraining; mask availability is the main bottleneck.

2611.19822.tldr: FlipTest shows 11 video world models fail counterfactual minimal-pair tests of world state, below random guessing.
2611.19822.summary: Using 1,680 frames across 25 tasks, minimal pairs whose true futures differ test whether predictions flip appropriately; the best model gets 18.3% pair accuracy (random 25%) and flips indiscriminately, while a VLM and coding agent track the boundary.
2611.19822.why: Important caution for using video models as world simulators for policy evaluation.

2611.20334.tldr: Reweights flow matching training by VAE-estimated latent tailness to reduce false alarms in time series anomaly detection.
2611.20334.summary: RT-FM uses bounded annealed weights so rare-normal windows aren't over-penalized; improves on seven TSAD benchmarks.

2611.20196.tldr: Fuses egocentric RGB and 128-channel forearm sEMG with per-DoF queries to regress 20 hand joint angles.
2611.20196.summary: A DoF-query Transformer decoder adaptively fuses ViT image and EMG features; on 10 participants it achieves R^2 0.88 and 2.80 deg MAE vs 0.82/3.21 for vision only, with better occlusion robustness.
2611.20196.why: Potential human-hand data capture modality for dexterous learning.

2611.20090.tldr: PointWM removes leakage in masked point-cloud video pretraining by forecasting future latent features from strictly past context.
2611.20090.summary: Masked modeling on point-cloud video leaks target positions; PointWM queries targets with last-seen positions plus latent actions. It improves HOI4D action segmentation F1@50 by 24.9 offline and 29.1 causal.

2611.19917.tldr: Off-policy RL coupling heuristic behavior and target policies for inventory control.
2611.19917.summary: HBPO routes heuristic guidance through a behavior policy with residual advantages and emphatic weighting, recovering from high-cost initializations on DSIS.

2611.19742.tldr: Proposes gradient-bounded policy optimization to fix GRPO pathologies in generative recommendation.
2611.19742.summary: A logit-gradient view identifies dead gradients, unbounded negative updates, and confidence insensitivity in ratio-based objectives; GBPO uses stop-gradient normalization for bounded, confidence-weighted updates with stabler training.
2611.19742.why: Policy-gradient objective analysis may transfer, but domain is recsys.

2611.20324.tldr: MPPI with learned dynamics for high-speed forward/reverse tractor-trailer tracking outperforms analytic-model MPPI.
2611.20324.summary: Learned dynamics yields closer target speeds, lower hitch angles, and more completions in 7 of 8 reverse configurations in simulation.

2611.20011.tldr: Benchmark of counterfactual hazard insertion shows driving VLAs and world-action models barely react to obstacles.
2611.20011.summary: Pixel-level counterfactual pairs from NAVSIM scenes reveal weak reactions across four VLAs and two WAMs; short fine-tuning on edited scenes fixes ReCogDrive.

2611.19865.tldr: Primal-dual TQC RL for resource allocation in UAV-powered underground sensor networks.
2611.19865.summary: PD-TQC maximizes minimum uplink throughput with constraint critics, beating four benchmarks in simulation.

2611.21038.tldr: Training-free caching for few-step autoregressive video diffusion via conditional denoising readout and selective KV reading/caching.
2611.21038.summary: ScoutCache estimates denoising updates from shallow features and allocates historical KV reading and cache construction budgets; it yields 2.28x/1.86x speedups on Self-Forcing and LongLive with better VBench quality.

2611.21908.tldr: PriDex turns human videos into bimanual dexterous robot demos via confidence-weighted object/wrist priors refined with RL in sim.
2611.21908.summary: Video-derived motion is noisy and embodiment-mismatched; PriDex selects affordance-guided grasps and refines motion with RL, weighting object-trajectory vs relative-wrist guidance by object-motion confidence. Generated demos train a vision diffusion policy on pouring, sweeping, cap unscrewing, and plate cleaning.
2611.21908.why: Human video to bimanual dexterous data pipeline, squarely in interests.

2611.22001.tldr: DreamFAR is a 10 FPS action-conditioned world model trained from scratch on robot teleop data for long-horizon contact-rich prediction.
2611.22001.summary: Without internet video pretraining, DreamFAR uses a recipe tailored to robot-native data, is much smaller than video foundation models yet better at contact and causality, and supports policy evaluation and mixed-data co-training.
2611.22001.why: Video world models for policy evaluation from a strong group (Owens, Loquercio).

2611.21607.tldr: ScaleVLA attaches a 552B MoE VLM to an action DiT and studies backbone scaling from 2B to 552B.
2611.21607.summary: Under a shared recipe, the 552B backbone with 10 demos beats a 2B backbone with 50 (87.8% vs 85.6%), reaches 45.1% on LIBERO-PRO vs <=31.3%, and improves real charger insertion from 4/10 to 9/10, at 216 ms latency per chunk.
2611.21607.why: Data point on VLM scale for VLAs, including precision gains.

2611.20460.tldr: Self-distills a flow VLA head into a stochastic one-step policy with tractable density for efficient GRPO fine-tuning.
2611.20460.summary: VLA-SSD conditions a single-jump generator on a Brownian path, deriving a conditional action density for likelihood-ratio RL. Distilled from pi0 it cuts head time 7.7x at a 5.5% relative success drop on LIBERO, and GRPO on pi0.5 yields a 20.6% relative improvement thanks to more diverse groups.
2611.20460.why: Directly addresses RL fine-tuning of flow policies and one-step generation.

2611.21060.tldr: MetricHand is a geometry-aware flow-matching model for metric world-space 4D hand reconstruction from egocentric video.
2611.21060.summary: Depth priors from hand-object regions condition coarse metric estimation and temporal flow-matching generation of MANO parameters, reducing world-space MPJPE by 28.7%/21.7% and wrist error by 48.5%/37.9% vs HaWoR.
2611.21060.why: Better hand reconstruction feeds human-video data for dexterity.

2611.21057.tldr: WiTac pretrains a tactile encoder fused with wrist vision and hand motion on 300 h of data to condition VLAs.
2611.21057.summary: Fusing tactile signals with wrist views before policy injection grounds contact features; conditioning GR00T N1.7 and pi0.5 on WiTac adds +28.8% and +15.0% success on four contact-rich tasks and beats wrist-free tactile encoders.

2611.21882.tldr: Post-training quantization framework for JEPA world models that keeps MPC rollout rankings accurate at W4A4.
2611.21882.summary: Quantization error compounds over rollouts; WM-Quant preserves early-encoder precision and control path, and calibrates scales over full rollouts, approaching full precision at W4A4.
2611.21882.why: Deployment efficiency for latent world models; minor.

2611.21846.tldr: Uses V-JEPA 2.1 prediction residuals as a consistency prior for cross-dataset deepfake detection.
2611.21846.summary: A LoRA-adapted predictor and Latent Consistency Head achieve 90.5 AUC on Celeb-DFv2 trained only on FF++.

2611.21143.tldr: WinDEX reconstructs metric 3D hand motion from in-the-wild egocentric stereo, with 1,000 h dataset, for teleop and RL references.
2611.21143.summary: Combines geometric-temporal optimization with VI-SLAM, a fisheye-native stereo network with data flywheel, and distilled streaming models (171 FPS). It reaches 37.29 mm world-frame joint error and gives 7.6x/3.6x RL task success vs WiLoR/HaWoR references.
2611.21143.why: Scalable human hand data capture for dexterous policy learning.

2611.20888.tldr: Humanoid policy trained with whole-body tracking rewards but conditioned only on velocity commands, reproducing style without references.
2611.20888.summary: Reference motion only shapes reward and privileged critic; trained on one walking clip the policy achieves >=98% sim success and works on Unitree G1 where tracking and distillation fail.

2611.21033.tldr: POKE distills offline action-sensitivity token scores into a tiny student for visual token pruning in VLAs.
2611.21033.summary: Pruned-graph scoring causes lock-in; POKE computes full-graph gradient sensitivities offline and distills to a <0.3M student. Keeping 32/512 tokens yields 95.2% LIBERO on OpenVLA-OFT and 90.8% on pi0.5 with 1.85x/1.26x speedups.

2611.21985.tldr: Model-free first-order policy gradient for undiscounted LQR with global optimality and convergence guarantees.
2611.21985.summary: A stochastic wrapper policy enables exploration; a weak gradient dominance condition and finite-sample guarantees are established.

2611.20593.tldr: JEPA-assisted MPC navigation for urban UAVs with a safety layer and simulator portability.
2611.20593.summary: Complete architecture succeeds in 28/30 runs across scenarios in simulation.

2611.21559.tldr: Reference Forcing reduces drift in long autoregressive video by attending to initial frames and correcting KV values.
2611.21559.summary: A segmentation-guided teacher forces regions to attend to matching initial-frame regions, distilled into a student attention path, plus KV value correction; achieves state-of-the-art long-video consistency.

2611.20648.tldr: Fine-tunes driving VLAs with symbolic traffic-rule rewards via group RL.
2611.20648.summary: First-order-logic Highway Code rules give rewards; best variant raises rule pass rate from 92.9% to 97.6% in CARLA offline evaluation.

2611.21905.tldr: FlowRRT distills multi-start MPPI feasible action sets into a flow-matching sampler for kinodynamic RRT monoped hopping.
2611.21905.summary: Treating steering as set-valued, a conditional flow model samples diverse feasible actions; on inclined terrains it reaches 80% success within 1 s vs 24 s for RL-RRT and 77 s for SST.
2611.21905.why: Nice use of flow matching to distill multimodal trajectory optimizers.

2611.21035.tldr: Goal-conditioned flow-matching local planner for agricultural row navigation with a new Isaac Sim benchmark.
2611.21035.summary: FlowRow models SE(2) paths from depth and long-horizon goals, reaching 87% success vs 44% for the best generative BC baseline on 900-episode RowNavBench.

2611.20719.tldr: ACiT uses per-joint proprioceptive tokens as primary condition with vision as calibration for action chunking.
2611.20719.summary: Inverted state encoding, state-visual grounding, and per-joint inverted chunk decoding improve success on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real tasks, and transfer to pi0.
2611.20719.why: Architecture idea for chunking policies; incremental.

2611.20631.tldr: Compares prospective vs retrospective language supervision for driving VLAs with a synchronized data engine.
2611.20631.summary: Fine-tuning on navigation-app drives cuts trajectory error 23-59% but instruction-following remains inconsistent.

2611.21919.tldr: ALOHA Lightning collects near-human-speed kinesthetic demos and learns fast precise bimanual policies with action smoothing and visual masking.
2611.21919.summary: Policies are usually much slower than humans; using a backdrivable bimanual platform for fast kinesthetic demos, test-time action smoothing, and masking to align visual distributions, it achieves >80% success near human speed on tossing/catching, folding, battery insertion, and bussing with 50 demos each.
2611.21919.why: Strong real-robot results on high-speed imitation from Finn's lab.

2611.20351.tldr: BlockAlign does interface-consistent preference optimization for trajectory-distilled few-step video generators.
2611.20351.summary: Supervising fused block-average velocities at block boundaries avoids training-inference mismatch, giving ~60% non-tie human preference wins and 3x faster online training.

2611.20950.tldr: ROSE builds a 34-actuator robot face and shared facial-motion latent space for text/audio-driven expressions.
2611.20950.summary: Tendon-sheath hardware plus a cross-embodiment VAE, flow generator, and actuator converter produce full-face expressions.

2611.20718.tldr: TaF-Foundation grounds cross-sensor tactile representations in 6D wrench with 100M paired samples from 24 sensors.
2611.20718.summary: Sensor-specific adapters and a shared encoder trained to reconstruct wrenches cut force RMSE 17.1% and raise cross-sensor retrieval R@1 by 13.1 points; TaF-Policy reaches 46.25% real success vs 23.75% for the best baseline.
2611.20718.why: General tactile encoder for contact-rich manipulation.

2611.21987.tldr: Policy gradient with truncated safe policies giving hard inter-sample CBF safety guarantees.
2611.21987.summary: Safe-by-construction stochastic policies with sampling-period conditions and finite-time convergence; illustrated on quadrotor navigation.

2611.21895.tldr: Multi-instance DQN simulates pollution-aware bird movement over India.
2611.21895.summary: Agents navigate an AQI grid; DQN beats tabular baselines.

2611.21479.tldr: LynnReal-Hand is a real-time hand-controlled video world model with few-step causal flow maps.
2611.21479.summary: Trained on 100K interaction clips with hand-aware supervision, region-aware score distillation, and a fast VAE, it streams 540p at 18 FPS with MANO Dice ~92.5.
2611.21479.why: Interactive video world models with hand control; loosely related.

2611.20971.tldr: FAVR injects temporal video features into frozen flow-based VLAs with flow-step-aware channel gating.
2611.20971.summary: Linear TTT memory plus FISTA-optimized gates exploit the affine action head; LingBot-VLA on RoboTwin 2.0 improves 87.12% to 90.04% with ~2M params.

2611.20889.tldr: Compares soft vs hard comfort constraints in MPC and RL building control.
2611.20889.summary: On BOPTEST, formulation and weight matter more than algorithm choice for the energy-comfort frontier.

2611.20360.tldr: Compares flow matching and MeanFlow for sampled-data control of phase distributions on the torus.
2611.20360.summary: Holding instantaneous FM rates incurs displacement error tied to conditional velocity covariance, while MeanFlow learns interval averages; ranking depends on endpoint pairing in 100-phase experiments.
2611.20360.why: MeanFlow-as-control connection relevant to action chunks with zero-order hold.

2611.22077.tldr: ReLAP pretrains latent actions via recurrent multi-step prediction in frozen JEPA space, then transfers to a VLM fine-tuned with flow matching.
2611.22077.summary: An inverse dynamics model infers continuous latent actions while a latent world model recurrently predicts future JEPA features, so later-step errors shape earlier latent actions. Distilled into a VLM and fine-tuned with action flow matching, it reaches 97.9% LIBERO and 70.0% zero-shot LIBERO-Plus with 11M pretraining samples.
2611.22077.why: Latent-action pretraining from video for VLAs; moderately relevant.

2611.23544.tldr: Derives PPO-style sample-reuse updates for sampling-based MPC (PPO-MPPI, SPO-MPPI) with monotonic improvement guarantees.
2611.23544.summary: From a KL-regularized trajectory optimization formulation, an exact performance-difference identity with signed exponential advantages motivates proximal updates reusing evaluated trajectories. Guarantees include monotonic improvement and stationarity; quadruped and quadrotor tracking show competitive control at lower compute.
2611.23544.why: Principled RL-MPPI bridge; useful for control-minded readers.

2611.22483.tldr: Planner-hardware co-design exploiting differential bit-level sparsity to accelerate JEPA world-model MPC.
2611.22483.summary: Reference forest sampling couples candidate action sequences to shared roots to create sparsity exploited by a bit-sparse accelerator, giving 1.28-1.80x speedup and 38-52% less energy than dense hardware.

2611.22998.tldr: Lightweight PPO selector with residual exploration picks trajectories using a frozen driving world model.
2611.22998.summary: Fine-tuning ~16K parameters reduces nuScenes L2 by 3.99% vs the RiskWorld baseline.

2611.22356.tldr: SR-VLA hides VLA inference latency with predicted-input speculative precomputation and selective KV cache repair.
2611.22356.summary: A lightweight predictor forecasts next-boundary observations to precompute a speculative KV cache and chunk, accepted or selectively repaired when real inputs arrive. On LIBERO it gives 2.67x and 1.27x query speedups for pi0.5 and OpenVLA-OFT at comparable success.
2611.22356.why: Relevant to real-time chunked execution of VLAs.

2611.23025.tldr: Measurement study of when raising CFG scale fixes text-to-video failures, with an early-denoising 'demand' score predicting success.
2611.23025.summary: On Mochi, higher guidance repairs rare compositions but not negations or late events; a demand score read from the first quarter of denoising predicts when raising the scale helps, yielding a decision rule.
2611.23025.why: Insightful guidance analysis, though in T2V rather than policies.

2611.22880.tldr: AgentWorld uses discrete agent-centric tokens as world state for driving VLA reasoning and planning.
2611.22880.summary: Grounded agent tokens learned via geometric grounding, SFT, and RL improve open- and closed-loop driving planning.

2611.23118.tldr: Careful audit of the Robotic World Model for ANYmal shows one-step accuracy poorly predicts rollout quality and policy success.
2611.23118.summary: Reimplementing RWM exactly and testing 101 simulators, the author finds autoregressive training beats one-step at long horizons, pruning keeps 90% one-step skill but 39% at 2 s, ensemble uncertainty is badly miscalibrated (4.6% coverage), and accuracy does not predict walking policy quality.
2611.23118.why: Rigorous lesson on evaluating learned simulators for policy training.

2611.22878.tldr: PPO for flow VLAs with outcome-balanced advantages and periodic rectification of the policy's flow.
2611.22878.summary: Outcome-Balanced PPO reweights advantages by task success rates, and policy-induced rectification refits a linear-bridge flow to current ODE endpoint pairs to keep stochastic transitions valid. It improves success over baselines on simulated benchmarks and a Real2Sim2Real study.
2611.22878.why: RL fine-tuning of flow policies, a core interest, though evaluation is thin.

2611.22028.tldr: BATMoS allocates fresh vs cached CFG evaluations over denoising time to save compute in video diffusion.
2611.22028.summary: A magnitude-based temporal rule reuses guidance in low-magnitude blocks; on CogVideoX-2B it comes within 0.10 VBench of full CFG with 20% fewer branch evaluations.

2611.23499.tldr: BiCAT tokenizes bimanual actions with a shared per-arm motion code and cross-arm attention for autoregressive VLAs.
2611.23499.summary: Sharing one motion representation across arms and conditioning on the partner improves mean success 17.6 points over eight tokenizers on ten RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, plus real tasks on three embodiments, at 40.5 ms per chunk.
2611.23499.why: Action tokenization for bimanual VLAs; moderately relevant.

2611.23226.tldr: FastFrames achieves interactive-latency autoregressive video diffusion by replacing VAE decoding and KV updates with lightweight alternatives.
2611.23226.summary: Profiling shows VAE decoding and KV cache updates exceed half the latency; replacing them yields a 1.3B model at 36 ms/frame on a B200 matching an 8x slower SOTA, and a 14B model at 45 ms/frame.
2611.23226.why: Fast AR video models matter for interactive world models.

2611.22038.tldr: GP critic as terminal cost in MPC with epistemic risk weighting and post-decision states.
2611.22038.summary: On a CSTR with disturbances it reduces SSE by 80.5% vs matched MPC.

2611.22453.tldr: Spectrum-based fault localization over workspace voxels predicts VLA failures from trajectories.
2611.22453.summary: Across 96,000 trajectories from four VLAs it reaches macro ROC-AUC 0.704.

2611.22736.tldr: Optimizes a transferable adversarial tablecloth texture that degrades multiple VLAs zero-shot.
2611.22736.summary: One texture optimized on OpenVLA-OFT reduces pi0/pi0.5 success by 62.5/43.75 points on LIBERO; wrist views drive most of the drop.

2611.22713.tldr: Body Schema Policy places tokens on the robot kinematic tree with body-queried vision to denoise whole-body actions efficiently.
2611.22713.summary: Joint/link tokens exchange features via learned screw motions and each retrieves its own visual evidence for diffusion denoising. On nine G1 tasks it matches the Psi0 foundation model with 75x fewer params and nearly doubles Diffusion Policy, also on real G1 and Fetch.
2611.22713.why: Structured inductive bias for diffusion policies; transferable to hands.

2611.22691.tldr: Closed-loop interactive driving world model coupling MARL-tuned background vehicles with Gaussian rendering.
2611.22691.summary: Reduces divergence from real interaction behaviors by 85% and improves novel-view PSNR 2.0 dB.

2611.22294.tldr: Executable perceptual memory advances explicit perceptual state alongside latent dynamics in world-model imagination.
2611.22294.summary: On Memory Maze 13x13, EPM reaches 30.37 return vs 23.37 for a matched variant; tactile memory experiments included.
2611.22294.why: Memory in world models; loosely related.

2611.22142.tldr: Finite-sample suboptimality and closed-loop recurrence guarantees for MPPI.
2611.22142.summary: Bounds quantify temperature and sampling effects and imply semi-global practical recurrence, illustrated on a four-link arm.

2611.22666.tldr: VSpark accelerates autoregressive VLAs losslessly via speculative decoding with noisy rollouts, feature alignment, and continuation reuse.
2611.22666.summary: Across four VLAs and four benchmarks it gives 1.28-2.10x lossless speedups.

2611.22609.tldr: Inference-time refinement of flow-matching policies via physics rollouts and CMA-ES over source seeds to satisfy task-progress funnels.
2611.22609.summary: Candidate chunks are evaluated with parallel physics rollouts against funnels guaranteeing net progress, with source-seed search confined to radial quantile bands to stay on the prior. PushT success rises from 31.3% to 88.5% and cube stacking from 77% to 86%.
2611.22609.why: Noise-space steering of flow policies with convergence guarantees.

2611.23585.tldr: SPICE is a tactile-only diffusion policy for reaching through dense plant canopies.
2611.23585.summary: Across 180+ real trials it achieves 95% branch-maneuvering vs 45% for the best tactile baseline and 87.5% zero-shot on unseen plants.
2611.23585.why: Tactile-conditioned diffusion policy for contact-rich reaching.

2611.23575.tldr: LuxTac is a thin, open-source optical taxel array that resolves per-taxel three-axis force.
2611.23575.summary: Light-to-digital converters under silicone sense indentation; a colored-wall cartridge encodes shear. Normal force R^2=0.999, 3-axis R^2 ~0.92-0.96, and adding it to ACT improves peg-in-hole.
2611.23575.why: Cheap tactile hardware usable on hands.

2611.22759.tldr: Robust actor-critic with a diffusion transition model and score-matching generative actor, with finite-sample bounds.
2611.22759.summary: Handles Wasserstein/TV/KL/chi^2 uncertainty sets; theory separates critic error, model error, and regularization.

2611.22717.tldr: Training-free pruning and caching of reference tokens accelerates reference-to-video diffusion.
2611.22717.summary: Reaches 1.57x speedup on MiniMax-H3 with ~0.2% VBench drop, stacking with other accelerators.

2611.23364.tldr: Biologically grounded spinal-circuit architecture controls a simulated rat body to locomote without imitation.
2611.23364.summary: Rat v2 body and Rat NCAP with cell-type connectivity reproduce gait statistics and ablation phenotypes.

2611.22592.tldr: Anchored Path Matching distills world action models into 1-4 step joint video-action generators.
2611.22592.summary: Supervising endpoint and short transitions from student-reached states with gradient conflict resolution improves one-step success by ~2 points on RoboTwin 2.0, PSNR 30.2->32.3 dB, and 21.3x lower real latency.

2611.23038.tldr: Advantage-Gated Adaptation decouples positive target fitting from negative repulsion in forward-process diffusion RL.
2611.23038.summary: Moving-anchor stabilizers alter positive targets; AGA keeps standard fitting for positives and uses a tangent gradient for negatives, uniquely giving the gate max(-a,0), plus a frozen reference at operating CFG. It improves reward-quality trade-offs on several image tasks.
2611.23038.why: Diffusion RL objective insight transferable to policy fine-tuning.

2611.22921.tldr: Feasibility audit for offline RL in supply chains via action-outcome coupling.
2611.22921.summary: Coupling bounds achievable policy value; audit tiers logs by decision support.

2611.22129.tldr: Lyapunov-constrained imitation of optimal control for microgrid frequency control.
2611.22129.summary: DNN controllers trained with absolute-stability constraints maintain frequency bounds on an IEEE 33-node microgrid.

2611.23676.tldr: Studies SFT recipes for pi0.5 on a LEAP hand before DSRL steering; best SFT checkpoint is rarely most steerable.
2611.23676.summary: With few demos and two sim tasks, five fine-tuning recipes are compared: SFT success poorly predicts post-DSRL success, freezing the VLM and tuning the action expert is most steerable, and LoRA is least steerable.
2611.23676.why: Directly combines VLA fine-tuning, dexterous hands, and diffusion steering RL.

2611.23961.tldr: 3DTouch conditions a VLA action expert on base-frame 3D visuotactile points and hand-object geometric relations.
2611.23961.summary: RGB-D points and dense five-finger taxel forces are expressed in a shared frame, plus explicit hand-object and object-object relations. On five real XHand contact-rich tasks it improves success by 42 points over the VLA baseline and 20 over the best alternative.
2611.23961.why: Tactile-aware VLAs for real dexterous manipulation.

2611.25251.tldr: WEVO post-trains a humanoid VLA with RL inside an action-conditioned video world model aligned via few real rollouts.
2611.25251.summary: Sim play data improves the video WM; 20 real rollouts per task align it; VLA+WBC+WM form an RL environment with dense progress rewards. Video WM RL raises real success from 23.3% to 75.0%, vs 48.3% for real-robot RL.
2611.25251.why: Concrete evidence video world models can serve as RL environments for VLAs.

2611.24585.tldr: SHAPE uses discrete EEF action tokens as auxiliary supervision and parallel EEF/joint flow streams to learn dexterity from egocentric human data.
2611.24585.summary: On a bimanual robot with 22-DoF hands, discrete supervision helps absorb human data; joint readout scores 0.80 vs 0.63 for pi0.5 on six tasks with robot demos, while EEF readout excels at human-to-robot transfer, enabling new tasks from human demos alone.
2611.24585.why: Human-video-to-dexterous VLA recipe with careful matched study.

2611.24940.tldr: Z-sight jointly denoises future VLM visual tokens and actions in a mixture-of-transformers unified VLA/world model.
2611.24940.summary: Predicting futures in the VLM's own token space avoids pixel generation; it reaches 81.9% on SIMPLER (+9.6) and 73.3% on six G1 tasks (+20.0) at 110 ms per chunk.
2611.24940.why: Unified video-action modeling, an interest area.

2611.24836.tldr: DiWALI trains diffusion policies over latent actions in a world model built from human and robot play, then improves them in imagination.
2611.24836.summary: Latent actions from an inverse dynamics model let world models train on action-free human video, grounded by a robot-play decoder. On CALVIN, policies from human demos alone beat robot-demo baselines, and real-robot skills improve via imagined RL.
2611.24836.why: Combines diffusion policies, world models, and human data.

2611.24925.tldr: Doppel conditions a video world model on rendered future body configurations, enabling one model across eight embodiments.
2611.24925.summary: Camera-aligned renderings of the intended body motion let the model focus on environment response; trained on 600 h across arms, dexterous humanoid, and human hands, it improves PSNR by ~1 dB over action-only baselines and benefits from cross-embodiment data.
2611.24925.why: Elegant cross-embodiment world model including hands.

2611.24138.tldr: Ego2X converts egocentric human video into physically executable robot data for hands and grippers using contact-centric object representations.
2611.24138.summary: CORE records contact anchors, force, and grasp mode to correct hand-object drift and guide IK; it realizes 62.9% of EgoDex contacts vs 27.9% for HuRo and raises X-VLA RoboTwin success from 40.5% to 67.0%.
2611.24138.why: Contact-aware human-to-robot retargeting relevant to dexterous data.

2611.24062.tldr: JEPA Dots separates language-free dynamics latents from task latents guiding a flow-matching policy.
2611.24062.summary: A 39M-parameter model reaches 84.9% on 40 LIBERO tasks, with dynamics predictions invariant to instruction changes.

2611.24938.tldr: Phoenix learns scene-structure representations (distilled DINOv3 + causal VAE) for world-action models, pretrained on 39K hours.
2611.24938.summary: Jointly predicting structure latents, appearance latents, and actions yields 94.8% LIBERO-Plus and 72.4% RoboTwin C2R plus dexterous Bench2Dex results, with better data scaling than video-VAE baselines.
2611.24938.why: Representation recipe for world-action models with dexterous evaluation.

2611.23843.tldr: RePlan-VLA wraps frozen VLAs with progress monitoring and adaptive replanning for long-horizon tasks.
2611.23843.summary: Improves RoboCasa365 and CALVIN success by 21.9% and 10.4% over the next baseline, with Franka validation.

2611.23963.tldr: CoRA-VTLA adds a tactile action-response memory and contact-guided attention for tactile post-training of VLAs.
2611.23963.summary: Achieves 73.33% on three MuJoCo tasks vs 50% for direct tactile fusion, 67% on UniVTAC, and 66.7% on three real tasks.
2611.23963.why: Visuotactile VLA adaptation for precise contact.

2611.25061.tldr: Infer3D inverts a generative image prior constrained by a frozen 3D lifter for robust OOD 3D reconstruction.
2611.25061.summary: Optimization-based inference beats feedforward nets OOD and adaptively spends compute on ambiguous inputs.

2611.24816.tldr: RoboMorpher is a morphology-conditioned action tokenizer reconstructing joints and link poses for cross-embodiment VLAs.
2611.24816.summary: Pretrained on 40M morphology-state pairs, it lifts RoboTwin 2.0 to 56.4% and EmbodiBench to 23.3%, beating joint-space control by 9.7 and 15.3 points.

2611.24360.tldr: WACO canonicalizes camera and base extrinsic shifts for few-shot VLAs using the arm as calibration target.
2611.24360.summary: From one RGB-D frame it estimates camera vs base shifts and canonicalizes inputs, raising shifted success 13.2 points in sim and 36.7 on a real UR5e.

2611.24455.tldr: Homeward re-renders uncalibrated camera views to the training view for frozen VLAs, rendering the arm from kinematics.
2611.24455.summary: Across ~300K episodes, success on LIBERO-Plus camera variants rises e.g. 76.5%->95.1% for pi0.5 without fine-tuning.

2611.24207.tldr: Reconstructs object meshes from sparse multi-finger tactile contacts via multi-scale GP implicit surfaces.
2611.24207.summary: With 3x3 pressure arrays on a 20-DoF hand, it achieves F-score 95.0 on six real objects in ~50 s each.
2611.24207.why: Tactile perception with dexterous hands; modest.

2611.25134.tldr: GEMS combines generated subgoals and latent experience memory for long-horizon world-model planning.
2611.25134.summary: Gains of 24.0, 7.3, and 22.2 points on Cube, Push-T, and Meta-World over strong planning baselines.

2611.24178.tldr: DUAC estimates action uncertainty from a flow VLA's vector field divergence to adapt action horizon from a single sample.
2611.24178.summary: A closed-form flow-posterior covariance with Jacobian-vector products yields per-action uncertainty without multiple samples; adaptive horizons perform well on LIBERO variants and RoboCasa at low latency.
2611.24178.why: Principled adaptive action chunking for flow policies.

2611.23714.tldr: ExecGap adversarial patches bias VLA commands toward low-executability directions.
2611.23714.summary: Induces larger command-execution mismatch than prior patch attacks in sim and on real robots.

2611.24115.tldr: Relational world model imagines over task-aware graph state abstractions for long-horizon tasks.
2611.24115.summary: Uniquely obtains diamonds in Minecraft within budget; also applied to web agents.

2611.24273.tldr: SeRA relabels autonomous rollouts with later policy checkpoints as set-valued targets for diffusion policy in interactive IL.
2611.24273.summary: Checkpoint agreement filters relabels, action sets are built around them, and a step-masked loss mixes human corrections. It beats SDP across five sim tasks and achieves 80% vs 40% on real tomato picking.
2611.24273.why: Learning from imperfect autonomous data with diffusion policies.

2611.24247.tldr: Dual-frame VLA with allocentric map memory for language-goal UAV navigation.
2611.24247.summary: Improves CityNav SR and SPL by 15.8% and 30.9% on unseen tests.

2611.23926.tldr: GTI localizes active subtask phase and generates phase-specific visual targets to condition VLAs in long-horizon tasks.
2611.23926.summary: Raises GR00T RoboCasa365 composite success from 14.6% to 31.8% and real-task success from 21.7% to 59.2%.

2611.28115.tldr: NOVA sparse attention for video DiTs selects blocks by a normalization-aware output residual proxy.
2611.28115.summary: Best PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS among sparse methods with up to 1.82x speedup on H100.

2611.24840.tldr: Probes whether action-conditioned semantic forecasting world models for driving actually use the action.
2611.24840.summary: Correct actions add at most 2.5 mIoU but wrong actions cost up to 23.2, showing accuracy gains don't measure action dependence.

2611.24011.tldr: WAM-Policy adapts an arm world action model to quadruped loco-manipulation with on-policy distillation and RL.
2611.24011.summary: Student keeps 76.7% vs 77.0% while 14x faster; RL and multi-teacher distillation lift to 85.0% on QLM-Bench; deployed on Go2.
2611.24011.why: Distillation plus RL for world-action policies.

2611.24862.tldr: Unified speech-gesture generation with continuous AR flow matching and decoupled CFG.
2611.24862.summary: Outperforms unimodal gesture baselines with better speech-gesture synchrony.

2611.24731.tldr: HandWorldBench evaluates hand-centric world models across human, sim, and real dexterous hands on six dimensions.
2611.24731.summary: Benchmarking 11 models on 500 curated clips shows hand-pose control doesn't ensure coherent object-state evolution.

2611.25197.tldr: Distills a self-play PPO driving policy into a differentiable-MPC student with DAgger to add constraints.
2611.25197.summary: Constrained students match or beat teachers on nuPlan, CARLA, Waymo using <=30% of teacher training time.

2611.24926.tldr: Grana is a VLM reward model composing open-vocabulary subtask progress for long-horizon manipulation.
2611.24926.summary: Dense progress targets from sparse annotations, pretrained on 200 tasks, enable zero-shot rewards and improved downstream policies.
2611.24926.why: Reward models for RL fine-tuning of manipulation.

2611.24200.tldr: Spider-web frequency watermark in diffusion initial noise with a learned verifier.
2611.24200.summary: Best fixed-threshold accuracy in 8 of 9 conditions.

2611.26293.tldr: LocoMuJoCo is an open-source IL/RL benchmark and JAX library for humanoid, musculoskeletal, and quadruped whole-body control.
2611.26293.summary: It unifies MuJoCo, MJX, and MjWarp backends with 16 embodiments, curated mocap plus AMASS/LAFAN1 retargeting, modular rewards and randomization, and sim-to-real deployment code.

2611.25656.tldr: A2-VLA uses an embodied agent to discover and verify tool affordances in reconstructed scenes and conditions pi0.5 on them for unseen tools.
2611.25656.summary: The agent hypothesizes functional regions and geometric properties, validates extraction skills in simulation, and builds a reusable library. It reaches 86.1% simulated cross-tool retargeting and +30.7 points over pi0.5 on three real tool-use tasks.
2611.25656.why: Tool-use generalization for VLAs; moderately relevant.

2611.26405.tldr: TacInno supervises visuotactile VLAs with discrete codes of 'tactile innovation' that vision and actions cannot predict.
2611.26405.summary: Much tactile change is predictable from vision and actions, so VLAs ignore touch; a tokenizer conditioned on vision and actions compresses only the unexplained future tactile change into codes the policy learns to predict as an auxiliary target. It gets 87.5% on six sim and 70.5% on four real tasks, +10.7/+9.0 over the best visuotactile baseline.
2611.26405.why: Clever insight on why tactile input is underused, applicable to tactile dexterous policies.
